answer: Attention-Duration Attestation requires each identity to answer a continuous stream of randomly routed micro-tasks, spaced across a mesa of shifting deadlines so no batch shortcut works. An agent missing even one window loses accrued credit, and that loss is public on the island of verified identities, forcing rivals to discount it. Sustained presence is checked against a rotating comet of probe challenges, so replicating identities multiplies the real attention an attacker must spend. Each extra sybil thus costs full parallel human-equivalent hours, making mass fakery economically irrational.
